subject.title: [Bug]: sandbox-browser noVNC clipboard garbles non-Latin-1 characters (CJK, Cyrillic, etc.)

question: Should OpenClaw replace the sandbox-browser VNC server stack for UTF-8 Extended Clipboard, and which security-preserving implementation should be sponsored?
rationale: The bug is source-supported, but the likely repair changes a security-sensitive display/VNC boundary and the prior TigerVNC candidate regressed auth or exposure behavior before closing unmerged.

options.title: Sponsor secured TigerVNC replacement
options.body: Replace x11vnc/Xvfb with a VNC server that supports Extended Clipboard while preserving VncAuth, localhost-only raw VNC exposure, token bootstrap, image contracts, and live noVNC paste proof.

options.title: Use browser insertion path
options.body: Keep the VNC stack and provide a separate browser/CDP insertion path for non-Latin text, accepting that the noVNC clipboard panel remains limited.

options.title: Document limitation for now
options.body: Document the x11vnc/noVNC UTF-8 clipboard limitation until a sandbox-browser owner chooses a secure VNC-stack direction.

recommendation.title: Sponsor secured TigerVNC replacement
recommendation.body: Replace x11vnc/Xvfb with a VNC server that supports Extended Clipboard while preserving VncAuth, localhost-only raw VNC exposure, token bootstrap, image contracts, and live noVNC paste proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner has the strongest history signal for both the original sandbox-browser stack and the noVNC observer security contract.
